props.gloss_en: and the flesh covering most of the rumen, in its majority [-- tereifa] (Shmuel's dictum, re-cited)
the inner rumen that was perforated, or [where] most of the outer was torn [-- tereifa]
the whole rumen entire -- that is the inner rumen
and which is the outer rumen? the flesh covering most of the rumen
the place that has no 'wool' [is the inner rumen]

questions.gloss_en: is Shmuel's 'flesh covering most of the rumen, in its majority' torn in its majority, or removed in its majority? The one proof is deflected; no resolution or teiku is recorded

supports.gloss_en: תפשוט ליה מדתנן: 'or most of the outer [rumen] was torn' -- and the bnei maarava in R' Yosei b'R' Chanina's name: the outer rumen is the flesh covering most of the rumen (= p_chitzon_basar_hachofe); so a TEAR in its majority is meant

deflected_by.gloss_en: מידי הוא טעמא אלא לשמואל, הכי אמר רבי יעקב בר נחמני אמר שמואל: מקום שאין בו מילת -- the dilemma is about Shmuel, and Shmuel's definition of the inner rumen is a different one (= p_ein_bo_meilat), so the bnei-maarava reading of the mishna proves nothing for him
